Hey there!

This feeling probably applies to every other community (Spanish, Russian, German, etc). VRChat obviously cannot allow itself to recruit T&S agents, support, or other sorts of members to meet the needs of every community as it would cost WAY too much. 

For reports: T&S could use an AI to translate video evidence, that way they could take action properly (if the evidence is obviously showing something actionable)

For communication and support: It would be interesting for you to explain what you mean by "More support for French creators, groups, and events" and "Clearer communication with the French community".

details:
We, players and members of the French community on VRChat, simply want to be heard.

For years, the French community has been very active on VRChat. We organize events, hangouts, and community gatherings, create worlds and avatars, help new players discover the game, and keep many spaces alive every day. A lot of French-speaking users spend a huge amount of time on VRChat because they genuinely love what the platform allows them to build and share.

But despite all this, many people in the French community feel a bit overlooked, especially when it comes to moderation, support, and communication.

A lot of French-speaking players experience harassment, insults, trolling, raids, and toxic behavior. The issue is that it’s often hard to properly report or explain these situations because of the language barrier. Not everyone is comfortable enough in English to clearly describe what happened or give all the necessary context.

Because of that, some players stop reporting altogether, feeling like they won’t be understood or that nothing will change. That can be really frustrating when all they’re trying to do is enjoy the game in a safe environment.

There also feels like there is a lack of visible French-speaking presence in moderation or community support—people who truly understand the French community, its culture, its groups, and the recurring issues within French-speaking spaces on VRChat. Many would simply like to feel that their community is taken seriously, just like other large communities on the platform.

This is not meant as criticism toward VRChat or its team. On the contrary, many of us care about the game and appreciate what has already been done. The reason this is being shared is because people want VRChat to keep improving and to feel better for everyone.

What we would like to see:

more French-speaking moderation;

better handling of reports written in French;

clearer communication with the French community;

more support for French creators, groups, and events;

more effective action against toxic behavior and harassment.

The French community has been active on VRChat for a long time and simply wants to be recognized and treated with the same attention as other major communities on the platform.
title: Better Recognition of the French Community on VRChat
